Bill.BriefDescription: Revising standards for antiharassment protection order hearings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hearings for antiharassment protection orders;and amending RCW 10.14.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 10.14.070 and 1992 c 143 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon receipt of the petition and after a showing of reasonableproof to the court that harassment has occurred, the court shall ordera hearing which shall be held not later than fourteen days from thedate of the order. Except as provided in RCW 10.14.085, personalservice shall be made upon the respondent not less than five court daysbefore the hearing. If timely personal service cannot be made, thecourt shall set a new hearing date and shall either require additionalattempts at obtaining personal service or permit service by publicationas provided by RCW 10.14.085. If the court permits service bypublication, the court shall set the hearing date not later thantwentyfour days from the date of the order. The court may issue an ex p. 1 SB 5763parte order for protection pending the hearing as provided in RCW10.14.080 and 10.14.085.
